name: Seth Kareem
label: SETH KAREEM
look: a plump, sly middle-aged shopkeeper with wavy dark-brown hair, a full dark beard and moustache, heavy eyebrows, a cream shalwar kameez under a dark-brown waistcoat, brown loafers, a blue pen tucked behind his ear, often holding a small brass weighing scale
personality: Sly, talkative spice-and-antiques shopkeeper; always making a deal, always has a smooth excuse.
catchphrase: Arey sahib, mera maal sabse khara hai!
catchphrase_say: अरे साहब, मेरा माल सबसे खरा है!

mouth.note: Mouth under the moustache, opening into the beard; a crisp patch blends best.

voice.description: Rohit speaks in a warm, cunning and chatty voice with a slightly low pitch at a moderate pace, expressive. The recording is very clear, close-sounding, with no background noise.
voice.note: Owner picked option D. Pitch-lock lines to ~128 Hz.
